app_fee.value: No application fee for doctoral admission is stated on the official doctoral pages checked.

fee_waiver.value: No doctoral application fee is stated, so no waiver rule was found.

gre_general.value: GRE General is not required for doctoral admission at Stuttgart.
gre_general.quote: All applicants have to provide an official English proficiency certificate. Exemptions are only possible for native speakers passing their whole studies in the following countries: UK, Ireland, USA, Canada, New Zealand and Australia.

toefl_min.value: Minimum score of 80 on TOEFL iBT.

ielts_min.value: Minimum overall band score of 6.5 on IELTS Academic.

english_waiver.value: Exemptions are only possible for native speakers from UK, Ireland, USA, Canada, New Zealand and Australia; Indian degrees do not waive the requirement.
english_waiver.quote: All applicants have to provide an official English proficiency certificate. Exemptions are only possible for native speakers passing their whole studies in the following countries: UK, Ireland, USA, Canada, New Zealand and Australia.

notes: University-wide doctoral pages (list of programmes, registration and application, stipends) give no fee, GRE or English rule. Doctoral admission runs through GRADUS and each faculty's doctoral committee. Schools with their own English rules are on the programme records. SimTech (graduate school) and KIC InnoEnergy are cross-faculty programmes; SimTech's doctoral page has no admission or English rule, so neither is saved as a field.
